and we complete the edge labels as follows:

 $\begin{array}[]{c|c|c}\hline\cr\hline\cr\text{Class}&\text{Edge labels}&\text{Edge weights}\\
\hline\cr E_{2}&[1,s-3]&[3,s-1]\\
E_{3}&\{s-2\}&\{s+1\}\\
E_{s+1}&[1,s-1]&[s+2,2s]\\
E_{s+2}&[s-1,s]&[2s+1,2s+2]\\
E_{2s}&[3,s]&[2s+3,3s]\\
\hline\cr\hline\cr\end{array}$ 

(We note that $E_{2}=\emptyset$ if $s=3$ , i.e., $G=K_{4}$ .)
In each case, all labels are in $[1,s]$ , and the edge weight sets are pairwise disjoint.
Hence, we obtain a total edge irregular $s$ -labeling.
